title: Trip planning — preferences emerge over turns

turns.user: I'm planning a 5-day trip and I want help thinking through it.
I have a really hard time with humid heat. Anything over 80°F with humidity is a nightmare for me.
Also, I love mountains. Coastal cities are fine but mountains are the priority.
Given all that, what would you suggest for late June?
Cool. Now if I told you my partner has a peanut allergy and we're vegetarian, does that change your recommendation?
